what: zusat: R Bindings for the 'CaDiCaL' SAT Solver — zusat-package
title: zusat: R Bindings for the 'CaDiCaL' SAT Solver — zusat-package
text: Solves Boolean satisfiability (SAT) problems using 'CaDiCaL', modern conflict-driven clause learning solver. Supports incremental solving, solving assumptions, inspection assumptions caused unsatisfiability. 'CaDiCaL' C++ sources bundled, external solver installation required.

title: The result of a solve — zusat_solution
text: variable integer, variable number value logical, value model. NA marks variable solver left unassigned either polarity extends model. outcome carried attribute rather column, object stays type-stable: unsatisfiable result data frame rows, different type. Calling code can therefore index result without first branching came back, result drops dplyr, ggplot2 join conversion. Read outcome sat_status() sat_is_sat(), never checking nrow(): satisfiable formula variables also zero rows.

title: zusat 0.0.0.9000
text: Initial version: R bindings bundled CaDiCaL SAT solver. sat_solve() solves formula incremental solver, returning type-stable data frame variable assignments. sat_solutions() enumerates models, vars project onto variables matter. read_dimacs() write_dimacs() format every solver benchmark set speaks. sat_limit() bounds hard solve may work, solve can return "unknown" rather running indefinitely. sat_constrain() adds clause one solve ; sat_fixed() reports literals proved root; sat_simplify() runs inprocessing alone. sat_at_most(), sat_at_least() sat_exactly() encode cardinality constraints, choosing pairwise sequential-counter encoding automatically.
